data.title: Contradicting Trump and Vance, Iran says no plans for IAEA inspections, asserts sovereignty at Hormuz
data.description: Trump claims Iran okayed inspections 'long into the future'; regime leaders hold talks with Oman on charging fees at waterway; in another pushback, envoy says Iran will be ‘only country’ to determine how to use its unfrozen assets, warns Lebanon clash poses risk to deal
